seo.title: Contact | Priya Raghavan
seo.description: Book a thirty-minute strategy call with Priya Raghavan, or enquire about keynotes and team intensives. Replies within two business days.

blocks.heading: Thirty minutes, no presentation.
blocks.body: I will ask what you have built, who currently knows about it, and what specifically prompted you to look for help now. You will leave with my honest read on whether you have an authority gap worth investing in and which pillar is weakest. If I am not the right person, I will say so and usually suggest who is.
blocks.responseTime: I reply personally within two business days.

form.consentNote: Used only to reply to you. No mailing list, no sequence.

fields.name: message
fields.label: What prompted you to reach out now?
fields.placeholder: The specific recent event is more useful than a general description.

faqs.question: Is the call a sales call?
faqs.answer: It is a diagnostic call that sometimes ends in a proposal. There is no deck and no second call with a closer. Roughly half of the calls I take end with me saying that the timing or the fit is wrong, which is a better outcome for both of us than a mismatched engagement.

faqs.question: What is your current availability?
faqs.answer: I hold six advisory engagements at a time and typically have one or two openings per quarter. Keynotes are booking from the second quarter onward. If nothing is open I will tell you when it will be rather than putting you through a process.

faqs.question: Do you work outside North America?
faqs.answer: Yes. Roughly a third of engagements are with leaders in Europe, the Gulf and Southeast Asia, run remotely with one or two in-person intensives. Keynote travel outside North America is quoted separately.
